title: J'ay un billard (Jacotin?)
desc: Jacotin (doubtful attribution), J'ay un billard. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: La Couronne. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From The 1520s Project (1520s-project.org, Jac3003); encoded by Benjamin Ory. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
